description: Planning consent is delayed beyond the assumed twelve weeks.
response: Pre-application meeting and a four-week buffer in the schedule.

description: The grid operator offers less export capacity than requested.
response: Submit the grid application early and hold a battery-only fallback.

description: Steel prices rise before the supply contract is signed.
response: Fix the steel price before the planning decision.

description: Market traders object to lost parking during construction.
response: Two community information sessions before construction starts.
